_description: Application-specific terms, field names, statuses, and domain vocabulary

terms.definition: A Shoppix.me email address auto-assigned to users during registration from a pool in the ActiveSubmissionEmailSelect table.
Database table holding a pool of Shoppix.me email addresses. Each row can be assigned to one AppUser.
Service bus queue that receives CreateUserProfileAsyncCommand messages after registration, forwarding data to DPP and GPM.
Service bus queue that receives scheduled notification messages for the ActiveSubmission email, delivered at 1pm the next day.
Backend service/module handling user profile creation, authentication, and related operations.
Core user entity — contains email, postcode, Facebook/Apple IDs, ActiveSubmissionEmail, tokens, and auth data.
The email entered during registration, stored before email confirmation. Becomes the primary Email after confirmation.
